title: Hamilton decompositions of the directed 7-torus at odd modulus via root-flat certificates and a prefix-count construction
summary: We prove that the directed seven-dimensional equal-side torus D_7(m) = Cay((Z/mZ)^7, {e_0, e_1, ..., e_6}) admits a directed Hamilton decomposition for every odd integer m >= 3. The proof has two main contributions. First, we introduce the root-flat certificate: a named verification framework in which a Hamilton decomposition of D_n(m) follows from three local conditions on a single root flat -- row Latinness, layer bijectivity, and primitive return maps.
